Deep recall requires populated isolated index/provider-backed setup for meaningful pass.
Depends on provider-backed memory_store fixture in isolated runtime.
Manifest contract preserved and Runtime Inspect shows the tool name after the local registerTool names fix; invocation not run against a real workspace knowledge target.

neo-arch unit tests passed; no runtime conversation smoke.

integrationBacklog.reason: Beta16 documents bounded session_end during shutdown/restart; PLUR1BUS can use it for final capture/flush with duplicate-capture guards.
Public docs expose transcript update events; useful for incremental Turn Journal capture without whole-file JSONL scanning.
Public runtime docs expose keyed state; useful for leases/idempotency instead of ad-hoc JSONL/lockfile state.
Cron-backed scheduled turns are documented; useful for Dreaming/Promote/Prune behind a feature flag.
PLUR1BUS v3.2.1 registers three provider IDs and Beta16 inspect surfaces them.
Useful for operator diagnostics later, but not needed for compatibility and should not broaden PLUR1BUS runtime authority now.

breakingChanges: Beta16 rejects plugins.entries.<id>.kind in config. This is correct OpenClaw behavior; PLUR1BUS kind must be manifest-level if added.
OpenClaw Beta16 blocks linked plugins from world-writable paths. This is a harness/security condition; after chmod go-w, Link-Lane passed.
plur1busFixRecommended: Add a deterministic mock embedding provider runtime smoke so memory_store -> memory_recall -> memory_forget can pass without real API keys or local model downloads.
Publish the local registerTool names fix in the next patch release if it should reach PLUR1BUS users.
